Docker is available. Let's check the network access to the registry. The guide says two methods: pull from registry, or build locally. Let's try to set up .env and pull. Let me check if we can reach registry.opencode.de.

First, let me set up .env. The guide says to configure, generate encryption key. Then docker compose pull. But the registry may require login. Let's try.

Also note API_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY is required. Let's create .env.

Let me check network connectivity.

action.command:
cp .env.example .env
sed -i "s|^API_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY=.*|API_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 32)|" .env
sed -i "s|^APP_DOMAIN=.*|APP_DOMAIN=localhost|" .env
sed -i "s|^INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD=.*|INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD=adminpass123|" .env
sed -i "s|^SWAGGER_HTTP_AUTH_PASSWORD=.*|SWAGGER_HTTP_AUTH_PASSWORD=swaggerpass123|" .env
sed -i "s|^LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL=.*|LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL=admin@example.com|" .env
grep -E "API_CREDENTIAL|APP_DOMAIN|ADMIN_PASSWORD|SWAGGER" .env
